newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russia prelim '96 gross grain harvest 74.6 mln T.
newsitem.headline: Russia prelim '96 gross grain harvest 74.6 mln T.

text.p: Russia's gross grain harvest for 1996 is 74.6 million tonnes, according to a preliminary figure released by the State Statistics Committee on Friday.

It said that the figure included output of maize and pulses, and that it comprised output by farms of all categories, including private holdings. Last year's gross grain output was 68.9 million tonnes, it said.
The committee, in a news release, said the grain harvest was essentially over and that insignificant areas sown to maize remained to be harvested.
Last year's net, drought-hit output was officially 63.4 million tonnes, but some officials have said that output may have been several million tonnes higher.
The committee said that gross grain output this year exceeded last year's by eight percent.
The Agriculture Ministry had forecast net grain output this year at 70-72 million tonnes.
Specialists have said that about eight percent of grain is lost after cleaning.
